get.summary: List all known rooms and their forecast status
get.description: Lists all known building rooms, including rooms without forecasts. Forecast values are read from the current room climate forecast CSV. Rooms without forecasts are marked with status 'no_forecast'. Forecasts based on input data older than 24 hours are marked as stale.
Returns temperature forecasts from the current CSV for the selected room. Results are sorted by target timestamp in descending order. The room identifier includes the building ID, e.g. A-A304.

get.description: Lists all known rooms from the available database tables, including rooms without generated forecasts. Rooms without forecasts are marked with status 'no_forecast'. Forecasts based on input data older than 24 hours are marked as stale.
